title: The Divine Soul Ranking
summary: An Ran shows the freshmen the Divine Soul Ranking, which pays daily spirit value to its top ten and is gamed by people on the verge of Heavenly Fusion, and the Heavenly Ranking for students of the three Heaven stages, headed by Shen Cangsheng, with Li Xuantong second, Wang Zhong eighth and Zhou Fan tenth. Mu Chen sees Bing Qing of the Ice Spirit Race, Mu Kui, and his Spiritual Land rival Yang Hong, who mocks him for being only at middle Spirit; they agree to settle it at the freshmen assembly. Mu Chen spends his spirit value on a First Class dormitory to share with Luo Li. To afford the 20,000 Divine Soul Pill that Luo Li says will take him to late Spirit, he enters the Divine Soul Ranking and takes third place from Mo Lun, earning enough to buy it. He sees that the Dragon Fish of Beiming essence and blood costs 7 million, and a clerk asks whether Luo Li is of the Luo God Race; she will not say. Mu Chen heads into the Thunder Realm to refine the pill.
events: An Ran explains the Divine Soul Ranking and the Heavenly Ranking; Shen Cangsheng is first.
Bing Qing, Mu Kui and Yang Hong are pointed out; Yang Hong taunts Mu Chen.
The freshmen dormitory sits on a Level 4 Spirit Collecting Formation; Mu Chen and Luo Li take a First Class dormitory.
Luo Li finds the Divine Soul Pill (20,000 spirit value) for Mu Chen.
Mu Chen takes third place on the Divine Soul Ranking from Mo Lun.
The Dragon Fish of Beiming essence and blood is listed at 7 million.
Mu Chen buys the Divine Soul Pill and goes to the Thunder Realm; Luo Li goes to a Level 5 Spirit Collecting Formation.
cultivation: Mu Chen is at Spirit, Middle Phase; the Divine Soul Pill is meant to take him to Spirit, Late Phase. The Heavenly Ranking is open only to those in the three Heaven stages.
